name: Shangri-La Asia Limited
summary: Shangri-La Asia Limited, an investment holding company, develops, owns/leases, operates, and manages hotels and associated properties worldwide. It operates through four segment: Hotel Properties, Hotel Management and Related Services, Investment Properties, and Property Development for Sale. The company develops, owns, operates, and leases office and commercial properties, and serviced apartments/residences; and operates restaurants and amusement parks.
